source_arguments.statement:
theorem completedSuzukiPacket_eq_archimedean_mul_zeta (a z : ℝ) :
    completedSuzukiPacket a (z : ℂ)
      = (archimedeanXiFactor (1 / 2 + ((z : ℂ) - (a : ℂ)) * Complex.I) *
            riemannZeta (1 / 2 + ((z : ℂ) - (a : ℂ)) * Complex.I))
        / (archimedeanXiFactor (1 / 2 + ((z : ℂ) + (a : ℂ)) * Complex.I) *
            riemannZeta (1 / 2 + ((z : ℂ) + (a : ℂ)) * Complex.I))
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem completedSuzukiPacket_eq_archimedean_mul_zeta (a z : ℝ) :
    completedSuzukiPacket a (z : ℂ)
      = (archimedeanXiFactor (1 / 2 + ((z : ℂ) - (a : ℂ)) * Complex.I) *
            riemannZeta (1 / 2 + ((z : ℂ) - (a : ℂ)) * Complex.I))
        / (archimedeanXiFactor (1 / 2 + ((z : ℂ) + (a : ℂ)) * Complex.I) *
            riemannZeta (1 / 2 + ((z : ℂ) + (a : ℂ)) * Complex.I))
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hminus : ((z : ℂ) - (a : ℂ)) = ((z - a : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  have hplus : ((z : ℂ) + (a : ℂ)) = ((z + a : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [completedSuzukiPacket, XiC, XiC, hminus, hplus,
    xi_eq_archimedean_mul_zeta (criticalPoint_ne_zero (z - a)) (criticalPoint_ne_one (z - a))
      (criticalPoint_Gammaℝ_ne_zero (z - a)),
    xi_eq_archimedean_mul_zeta (criticalPoint_ne_zero (z + a)) (criticalPoint_ne_one (z + a))
      (criticalPoint_Gammaℝ_ne_zero (z + a))]

method.description: Proof rewrites completedSuzukiPacket using archimedeanXiFactor and riemannZeta via equality of complex expressions derived from real arithmetic.
steps: apply xi_eq_archimedean_mul_zeta for (z - a) and (z + a)

    _ ≅ F ⋙ e'.inverse ⋙ eA.inverse := associator _ _ _
    _ ≅ F ⋙ 𝟭 B' ⋙ e'.inverse ⋙ eA.inverse := isoWhiskerLeft _ (leftUnitor _).symm
    _ ≅ F ⋙ (eB.inverse ⋙ eB.functor) ⋙ e'.inverse ⋙ eA.inverse :=
      isoWhiskerLeft _ (isoWhiskerRight eB.counitIso.symm _)
    _ ≅ (F ⋙ eB.inverse ⋙ eB.functor) ⋙ e'.inverse ⋙ eA.inverse := (associator _ _ _).symm
    _ ≅ ((F ⋙ eB.inverse) ⋙ eB.functor) ⋙ e'.inverse ⋙ eA.inverse :=
      isoWhiskerRight (associator _ _ _).symm _
    _ ≅ (F ⋙ eB.inverse) ⋙ eB.functor ⋙ e'.inverse ⋙ eA.inverse := associator _ _ _
    _ ≅ (F ⋙ eB.inverse) ⋙ (eB.functor ⋙ e'.inverse) ⋙ eA.inverse :=
      isoWhiskerLeft _ (associator _ _ _).symm
    _ ≅ (F ⋙ eB.inverse) ⋙ (G ⋙ eA.functor) ⋙ eA.inverse :=
      isoWhiskerLeft _ (isoWhiskerRight hG _)
    _ ≅ ((F ⋙ eB.inverse) ⋙ G ⋙ eA.functor) ⋙ eA.inverse := (associator _ _ _).symm
    _ ≅ (((F ⋙ eB.inverse) ⋙ G) ⋙ eA.functor) ⋙ eA.inverse :=
      isoWhiskerRight (associator _ _ _).symm _
    _ ≅ ((F ⋙ eB.inverse) ⋙ G) ⋙ eA.functor ⋙ eA.inverse := associator _ _ _
    _ ≅ ((F ⋙ eB.inverse) ⋙ G) ⋙ 𝟭 A := isoWhiskerLeft _ eA.unitIso.symm

    (T : E →L[ℝ] E) (first second : SymmetricSupportInverse T) :
    first.inverse = second.inverse
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hfirstRight : first.inverse * first.support = first.inverse := by
    have h := congrArg star first.support_mul_inverse
    simpa [star_mul, first.selfAdjoint_support.star_eq,
      first.selfAdjoint_inverse.star_eq] using h
  calc
    first.inverse = first.inverse * first.support := hfirstRight.symm
    _ = first.inverse * second.support := by
      rw [symmetricSupportInverse_support_unique T first second]
    _ = first.inverse * (T * second.inverse) := by rw [second.metric_mul_inverse]
    _ = (first.inverse * T) * second.inverse := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = first.support * second.inverse := by rw [first.inverse_mul_metric]
    _ = second.support * second.inverse := by
      rw [symmetricSupportInverse_support_unique T first second]
    _ = second.inverse := second.support_mul_inverse

theorem suzukiCausalDepthGammaSupportedGeneralizedInverse_inverse_sub_memSchattenClass_one
    {A₀ A₁ : GammaOp}
    (d₀ : SuzukiCausalDepthGammaSupportedGeneralizedInverse A₀)
    (d₁ : SuzukiCausalDepthGammaSupportedGeneralizedInverse A₁)
    (hA : MemSchattenClass 1 (A₁ - A₀)) :
    MemSchattenClass 1 (d₁.inverse - d₀.inverse)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hP :=
    suzukiCausalDepthGammaSupportedGeneralizedInverse_support_sub_memSchattenClass_one
      d₀ d₁ hA
  have hnegA : MemSchattenClass 1 (A₀ - A₁) := by
    simpa using hA.one_neg
  have hleft : MemSchattenClass 1
      (d₁.inverse ∘L (d₁.support - d₀.support)) :=
    memSchattenClass_one_comp_left hP d₁.inverse
  have hmiddle : MemSchattenClass 1
      ((d₁.inverse ∘L (A₀ - A₁)) ∘L d₀.inverse) :=
    memSchattenClass_one_comp_right
      (memSchattenClass_one_comp_left hnegA d₁.inverse) d₀.inverse
  have hright : MemSchattenClass 1
      ((d₁.support - d₀.support) ∘L d₀.inverse) :=
    memSchattenClass_one_comp_right hP d₀.inverse
  have hid : d₁.inverse - d₀.inverse =
      d₁.inverse ∘L (d₁.support - d₀.support) +
        (d₁.inverse ∘L (A₀ - A₁)) ∘L d₀.inverse +
          (d₁.support - d₀.support) ∘L d₀.inverse := by
    have hmetric0 := d₀.metric_mul_inverse
    have hmetric1 := d₁.inverse_mul_metric
    have hsupport0 := d₀.support_mul_inverse
    have hsupport1 := d₁.inverse_mul_support
    simp only [← ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def] at hmetric0 hmetric1 hsupport0 hsupport1 ⊢
    noncomm_ring [hmetric0, hmetric1, hsupport0, hsupport1]
  rw [hid]

  one_le_gamma := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le I.one_le_gamma J.one_le_gamma
  one_le_gammaInv := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le J.one_le_gammaInv I.one_le_gammaInv
  forward := fun n => I.forward n * J.forward n
  inverse := fun n => J.inverse n * I.inverse n
  forward_inverse := by
    intro n
    calc
      (I.forward n * J.forward n) * (J.inverse n * I.inverse n) =
          I.forward n * (J.forward n * J.inverse n) * I.inverse n := by
            noncomm_ring
      _ = I.forward n * 1 * I.inverse n := by rw [J.forward_inverse n]
      _ = 1 := by simpa using I.forward_inverse n
  inverse_forward := by
    intro n
    calc
      (J.inverse n * I.inverse n) * (I.forward n * J.forward n) =
          J.inverse n * (I.inverse n * I.forward n) * J.forward n := by
            noncomm_ring
      _ = J.inverse n * 1 * J.forward n := by rw [I.inverse_forward n]
      _ = 1 := by simpa using J.inverse_forward n
  maps_forward := by
    intro n x hx
    exact I.maps_forward n (J.maps_forward n hx)
  maps_inverse := by
    intro n x hx
    exact J.maps_inverse n (I.maps_inverse n hx)
  norm_forward := by
    intro n
    calc
      ‖I.forward n * J.forward n‖ ≤ ‖I.forward n‖ * ‖J.forward n‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ I.gamma ^ n * J.gamma ^ n := mul_le_mul (I.norm_forward n) (J.norm_forward n)
          (norm_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one I.one_le_gamma) _)
      _ = (I.gamma * J.gamma) ^ n := (mul_pow _ _ _).symm

    intro n

          (pow_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one J.one_le_gammaInv) _)
      _ = (J.gammaInv * I.gammaInv) ^ n := (mul_pow _ _ _).symm
